newsitem.title: JAPAN: PC-server shipments in Japan rise 88.9 pct in '96.
newsitem.headline: PC-server shipments in Japan rise 88.9 pct in '96.

text.p: Shipments of personal computer (PC) servers in Japan rose 88.9 percent in 1996 to 127,150 units, market research firm IDC Japan Ltd said on Wednesday.
The growth in 1996 was higher than in 1995, when the rate was 73.5 percent, it said.

But it was still short of IDC's previous projection, due to slower sales of PC servers as replacements for proprietary computers developed for Japanese firms' in-house use, said IDC, a subsidiary of U.S. firm International Data Corp.

IDC said that NEC Corp had the largest market share last year at 18.6 percent, followed by Fujitsu Ltd with 17.4 percent, Compaq Computer Corp with 16.4 percent and IBM Japan Ltd, a subsidiary of International Business Machines Corp, at 13.8 percent.
IDC said that one reason for the continued growth was the increasing need for PCs in the workplace and increased use of local area networks in companies.
